qa: The effects trigger simultaneously, so the player can choose the activation order.

text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text: When this card would be played, if you have a Digimon with the [ACCEL] trait, reduce the play cost by 5. [On Play] [When Digivolving] ＜De-Digivolve 2＞ 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, 1 of their Digimon gets -5000 DP until the end of their turn. [End of Your Turn] This Digimon and any of your other Digimon may DNA digivolve into a Digimon card with [Chaosmon] in its name in the hand. Then, the DNA digivolved Digimon may attack.

text_sections.label: Inherited Effect
text_sections.text: [Opponent's Turn] [Once Per Turn] When one of your opponent's Digimon attacks, you may change the attack target to this Digimon.
